title: Unit Event — Putting Feelings Into Words — Episode6 We Had to Fight

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need has begun performing in earnest at the live house. Honami comes up with a schedule to ensure that they can all work on their performance without overexerting themselves, but then she notices that Shiho seems different from usual...

rows.Line: Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're still working on our new song, right? Based on what I saw today, it's going to take a few more days to hammer everything out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if we have to start selling tickets to play in shows, we won't have enough time to create, practice and finish any new songs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So for now, I want all of you to keep working on our new song. You can leave selling tickets to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shiho's right...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika and Saki are doing their best to finish their song, and me... I need to keep practicing to get ready for our next show.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Because of how much stage experience she already has, Shiho can learn new songs really fast...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So I can't help but agree with her when it comes to her being the one to sell tickets for us while we keep practicing...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, I still want to help her somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If I ask my friends and other acquaintances, I might be able to actually sell a few...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But she won't want me to right now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How can I get her to understand...?
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I didn't know what to do and ended up in SEKAI. Maybe I should go ask to see if I can play the drums a little...)
Again, that's not the issue here...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh...?
That voice...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why can't you just do things like we planned, Rin?! Don't you ever listen to anything I say?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I just don't like how we're playing this right now! I can't show Miku-P this! Can you?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you'll make her and the others worry if you keep pushing yourself like this!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on, you two?
It's not good to fight. Please, try to calm down...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't mind them. This is something they need to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? B-But...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Apparently, Rin's been working on a song for Miku and really wants to blow her away.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's been practicing so much but isn't happy with the way she's playing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Lately, she's even been practicing during her days off.
Len found out and now he's pretty mad.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Rin... I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can't you just tell me what's bothering you? I might be able to help you. We can work on it together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You don't have to keep doing this to yourself. Won't this ultimately hurt the way you perform?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... I...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know that more than anyone else!
Len, you dummy!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: D-Don't cry like that...! Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no...
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Usually, they just talk it out and figure out a solution together, but that may not be the case this time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean we should stop this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, you may be right.
I'll be sure to talk to them later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
To be continued...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shouldn't you go after her, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We're both too wound up right now to get through to each other. It might be better to wait a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... I'll go check up on her later.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But what are you doing here, Honami? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
So Shiho's been selling tickets all by herself...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, she has, and I agree with her motives...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika and Saki are busy finishing up our new song, while I need to keep practicing if I'm going to be ready to play it during our next show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Logically, this leaves Shiho in the best position to sell these tickets.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's what she should do, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're a band. We're supposed to be working together, so I don't want to see her having to suffer like this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. And it's been bothering you quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to help her, but I don't know how I'm supposed to convince her of that...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it sounds like you already know what you want to do, Honami. You genuinely want to be there for Shiho, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why don't you just tell her that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I tried already...
That's why I'm here right now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: At this rate, we'll end up fighting and making things worse...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's wrong with that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Admittedly, Rin and I fight a lot, but if I ever really need to tell her something, I do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And you're trying to go pro, right? You have to work together, which also means you're not always going to agree on everything.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree with Len.
You won't be able to perform very well if you keep this pent-up inside you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And I'm sure you'll be fine.
You girls always find a way to get through to each other.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (In terms of what's best for our band, it seemed like the correct choice... At least, that's what I believed...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But if I don't tell her now, I might not get another chance.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I don't want Shiho to suffer all on her own like this. I want to help her in any way I can...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can you do it, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I think so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much, MEIKO, Len.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm going to go tell Shiho exactly how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Great! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, that just leaves you and Rin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're hiding behind the door, right, Rin? Come on out.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, I... Um...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to go so far...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry for being such a blockhead too. I know that you were just looking out for me...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thanks for understanding.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, let's practice together while taking it easy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that went pretty well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I hope the girls can figure things out and achieve a similar result...)
